purpose: Teach: 吐き気/日本食/静寂/脱力/化合/矢先/在来/祭典

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、車に乗って吐き気がしたら教えてね
lines.en: Sho, if you feel car-sick on the way, let me know right away, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, practical instruction. Warm but matter-of-fact. No fussing. A mother's quiet attentiveness — checking in without hovering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんの作る日本食が一番好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I like Grandma's Japanese food the best!
lines.style: Bright, immediate enthusiasm. Unguarded. The kind of honest declaration a six-year-old makes without calculating. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、夜のお家の静寂、不思議な感じね
lines.en: Sho, there's something strange about the quiet of the house at night, isn't there?
lines.style: Soft, wondering. Speaking partly to herself. Gentle curiosity — not quite a question, more an invitation to notice with her. Dreamlike pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、宿題終わったあと脱力しちゃった
lines.en: Mom, after I finished my homework I just kind of… ran out of energy.
lines.style: Small, slightly self-aware laugh underneath. Rueful honesty. Not complaining — observing his own collapse with quiet surprise. Trailing fadeout.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが化合物のお仕事の研究をしてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's been doing research on compounds lately.
lines.style: Reflective, almost conversational. Sharing information gently, as if thinking aloud. Warm but unhurried — not explaining, just offering the thought.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、勉強を始めた矢先におやつ食べたよ
lines.en: Mom, I started studying and then I just ended up eating a snack instead.
lines.style: Self-deprecating and honest. A small rueful smile in the voice. Not defensive — reporting his own mild failure with gentle irony. Brief pause before 'snack.'

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、田んぼで在来種のお米を育ててらっしゃるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your father's been growing native-variety rice in the paddies.
lines.style: Warm, admiring tone tucked underneath. Speaking with quiet pride in his work. Unhurried — letting him picture it. Slight lift on 'native-variety,' pride in the precision.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと地域の祭典に行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to go to the local festival with Dad!
lines.style: Clear, open longing. Not demanding — hoping. The brightness of a child who wants something simple and true. Unguarded. Slight eagerness on 'with Dad.'
